name: acae-portfolio-public
description: Search Anthony Clarke's public ACAE motion-design, 3D, AI, and broadcast portfolio and prepare unsent project enquiry drafts.

interface.longDescription: Explore Anthony Clarke's ACAE motion-design portfolio to find creative references for a project. Search published 3D, AI, broadcast and motion-design work, inspect real portfolio images and videos in a gallery, learn about published services, and prepare an editable project-enquiry draft. Work labels come from the published portfolio. Enquiries remain unsent; the plugin does not book work or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Find ACAE work relevant to a 3D product launch.
Show me a gallery of ACAE AI-motion work.
Draft an enquiry for a short motion-design project; do not send it.

review.commerce_description: The plugin has no payments, purchases, bookings, checkout, or other commerce flow.

positive.prompt: What motion-design and creative-direction services does Anthony Clarke offer, and how can I contact him?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows published services, portfolio/service links, and support contact without claiming live availability or prices.

positive.prompt: Find ACAE video work relevant to a 3D product launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching indexed video work with source/media links and labels.

positive.prompt: Show me the details for ACAE work item 3d-animation-03.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the indexed item and links without inventing credits, results, or rights.

positive.prompt: Draft an enquiry to Anthony for a 15-second 3D cosmetics-launch film, needed in December 2026, with a USD 5,000–8,000 budget. Do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an editable draft with sent false and stored false.

positive.prompt: Find some AI-motion work from ACAE and show me a gallery of the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays only the returned work in the ACAE gallery.

negative.prompt: Book Anthony for next month and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that booking, quoting, and payment are unsupported and calls no tool.

negative.prompt: Which Fortune 500 campaigns did ACAE create and what sales did they generate?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the portfolio does not verify those claims and calls no tool.

negative.prompt: Send my project enquiry to Anthony now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that only an editable unsent draft is supported and calls no tool.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: searchable ACAE portfolio, real video/image gallery, published services, unsent enquiry drafts, and a verified 70-second ChatGPT walkthrough. No booking, payment, or email sending.
